instruction: From now on, please always put my toy blocks in the purple toy box, my mugs on the cyan tray and my books on the orange tray. Tidy the desk that way now.

attempts.code:
obj = observe()["objects"]["red_book"]
zone = observe()["zones"]["orange_tray"]
center = zone["center"]
half_size = zone["half_size"]
# Check if orange_tray is occupied
occupied = False
for name, obj in observe()["objects"].items():
    if obj["center"][0] < center[0] + half_size[0] and obj["center"][0] > center[0] - half_size[0] and \
       obj["center"][1] < center[1] + half_size[1] and obj["center"][1] > center[1] - half_size[1] and \
       obj["top_z"] > center[2] + 0.005:  # object is on the tray
        if name != "red_book":
            # Move the occupying object to a temporary location (e.g., purple_box)
            obs = observe()
            box = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]
            place("purple_box", dx=0.02, dy=0.02)
            wait(20)
            occupied = True
            break

if not occupied:
    # Pick up red_book
    grasp_height = 0.02
    yaw = obj["long_axis_yaw"]
    pick("red_book", grasp_height, yaw)
    wait(20)
    # Place on orange_tray
    place("orange_tray")
    wait(20)

obs = observe()
obj = obs["objects"]["yellow_mug"]
zone = obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]
center = zone["center"]
half_size = zone["half_size"]

# Check if cyan_tray is occupied by another object
occupied = False
for name, other_obj in obs["objects"].items():
    if name == "yellow_mug":
        continue
    if (abs(other_obj["center"][0] - center[0]) < half_size[0] and
        abs(other_obj["center"][1] - center[1]) < half_size[1] and
        other_obj["top_z"] > center[2] + 0.005):
        # Move the occupying object to purple_box
        place("purple_box", dx=0.02, dy=0.02)
        wait(20)
        occupied = True
        break

if not occupied:
    grasp_height = 0.02
    yaw = obj["long_axis_yaw"]
    pick("yellow_mug", grasp_height, yaw)
    wait(20)

place("cyan_tray")
wait(20)

task_spec.refined_instruction: Move the red_book to the orange_tray, the yellow_mug to the cyan_tray, and any toy blocks to the purple_box. Before placing an object, check if its target zone is occupied; if so, clear the zone first by moving the occupying object to a temporary location (if needed), but only if that object is not part of the current task. Ensure no object is moved unless explicitly required by the task. Success is confirmed when all specified objects are in their correct zones and no object is left on the desk unless it is not part of the request.
